#!/bin/bash
# hcol.sh <worktree> <block> <budget> <exclude> <min_gb>
case $1 in /*) cd $1;; *) cd /tmp/claude-1000/wt/$1;; esac
N=${6:-$2_12}; W=/home/ubuntu/w13work/$N
OT_CHIP_PERIOD_NS=0.833 OT_REMOTE_NATIVE=1 OT_GATE_EXCLUDE=$4 OT_GATE_MIN_GB=$5 /tmp/claude-1000/remote_gate.sh bash -c "export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/home/ubuntu/.local/w13lib; mkdir -p /home/ubuntu/w13work; docker run --rm -v /home/ubuntu/w13work:/w alpine:latest rm -rf /w/$N; mkdir -p $W && python3 tools/chip_assembly/harden.py --block ot_gpu_$2 --work $W --phase synth && python3 tools/chip_assembly/harden.py --block ot_gpu_$2 --work $W --phase pnr --budget results/physical_abi3/asap7/chip/budgets/$3.json && python3 tools/chip_assembly/harden.py --block ot_gpu_$2 --work $W --phase corners"
